evidence_items.content: Canonical coding contract defines Dimension Status D/I/U/NA/C; U is used for insufficient evidence, NA for structurally not applicable, and C for competing values within the same Version Scope. Unknown values must not be filled with the most likely code. H3 primary is exactly one when status is D/I, with at most two secondary codes. D21 values are A0 anonymous/abstract, A1 general real-world background, A2 specific identifiable real target, A3 real institution/social history necessary to model existence, and A4 concrete historical fact/record/existing lore integrated into the causal structure. D21 coding must distinguish a source being real from the lore model itself depending on reality.
evidence_items.selection_reason: 候補A-FをD01-D21全次元でfinal status/code化する際のcanonical coding contractをEvidenceとして固定するため

evidence_items.content: Candidate A『名前が旧橋へ戻る』uses the Yoshida Bridge/Toyobashi name-location re-placement anchor. INV-000031 describes D07 as the puzzling split of one bridge identity across two current locations; D09 as naming plus historicization; D10 as causalizing the name-place relation; D11 as referring to the two present bridges with the mismatched name; D13 as route recognition being pulled back to the historically corresponding point; D15 as disturbance of position/direction sense; D16 as single-to-continuous episode; D17 as recovery by stating current location rather than bridge name; D18 as L1-centered.
evidence_items.selection_reason: formal candidate-side D01-D21 codingの直接入力となるcandidate model featuresを固定するため
